title: EUREKA HYBRID04 576 + VIDEO MIDI
author: analoglav
description: 576 original 128x64 yellow/black 04 HYBRID user frames. MIDI+YES toggles. Stock FUNC+BANK, FUNC+TRACK1-4, PTN+TRACK1-4 mute keys/LEDs pass through unchanged while animation continues. AUTO MIDI CC40 GLITCH, CC65 STUTTER, CC67 SPEED, CC68 SCRUB, CC69 INVERT; only captured while EUREKA is ON. Note-responsive JUMP/REVERSE/SPEED/STUTTER and tempo remain. No changes to stock audio.
